review.feedback: Exact project authorization is incomplete. authorize() checks ownership only when arguments contain workflowId, so execution reads using executionId have no project ownership check. Separately, worker_request() permits proof-less get_workflow_details calls for any nonprotected workflow ID. These paths allow resource reads outside the configured project. Require project authorization for resource-scoped reads and verify execution ownership, rejecting reads whose scope cannot be established. The reported tests pass; deferred workflow safety and pipeline integration are not blockers for this increment.
